representative_papers.title: Conflict-Aware RAG: Multi-Stage Learning with Conflict Signals for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: RAG systems fail when integrating conflicting web-sourced information, leading to unreliable responses
representative_papers.approach: Multi-stage optimization using conflict signal from generative probabilities with SFT, DPO, and reranking
representative_papers.contribution: Conflict-Aware RAG robustly handles knowledge conflicts via preference optimization

representative_papers.title: OpenDecoder: Open Large Language Model Decoding to Incorporate Document Quality in RAG
representative_papers.problem: RAG systems assume equal relevance of retrieved documents; variable document quality not incorporated
representative_papers.approach: OpenDecoder leverages explicit quality indicators (relevance, ranking, QPP scores) in LLM decoding
representative_papers.contribution: RAG robustness improved through explicit document quality evaluation in generation

representative_papers.title: PruneRAG: Confidence-Guided Query Decomposition Trees for Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: Evidence forgetting and inefficiency in RAG systems during deep reasoning chains
representative_papers.approach: Confidence-guided query decomposition tree with adaptive expansion and fine-grained retrieval
representative_papers.contribution: PruneRAG reduces retrieval overhead while preserving evidence through multi-hop reasoning

representative_papers.title: Rise: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Enhanced Immersive System for Education
representative_papers.problem: Limited hardware resources and interactivity constraints in intelligent education systems
representative_papers.approach: Lightweight RAG-enhanced immersive system integrating MCP and digital human technologies
representative_papers.contribution: Rise enables adaptive, personalized learning with analytics and attention monitoring on devices

representative_papers.title: Inference Cost Attacks for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: RAG-enhanced LLMs vulnerable to high inference costs through knowledge base poisoning
representative_papers.approach: Inject malicious documents into knowledge bases via LLM agents and reinforcement learning
representative_papers.contribution: CREEP framework with MA-GRPO algorithm for effective inference cost attacks on RAG systems

representative_papers.title: DA-RAG: Dynamic Attributed Community Search for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: G-RAG underutilizes graph topology; static communities fail on dynamic complex queries.
representative_papers.approach: Dynamic attributed community search extracts relevant subgraphs; chunk-layer graph index.
representative_papers.contribution: Outperforms RAG methods by 40%; reduces index time and token overhead by 37-41%.

representative_papers.title: When to Trust: A Causality-Aware Calibration Framework for Accurate Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: KG-RAG models produce overconfident predictions with incomplete or unreliable retrieved subgraphs
representative_papers.approach: Causality-aware calibration with counterfactual prompting and panel-based re-scoring mechanism
representative_papers.contribution: Improves prediction calibration while maintaining accuracy via intervention-aware uncertainty estimation

representative_papers.title: IRAG: Robust Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Hazard Separation
representative_papers.problem: Multimodal RAG systems vulnerable to retrieval poisoning attacks affecting image-text fusion
representative_papers.approach: Hazard separation framework isolating contamination via redundancy and consensus
representative_papers.contribution: IRAG defense restores 15-30 percent answer accuracy under poisoning while reducing poisoned rate below 7 percent

representative_papers.title: NeocorRAG: Less Irrelevant Information, More Explicit Evidence, and More Effective Recall via Evidence Chains
representative_papers.problem: RAG retrieval improvements do not consistently improve reasoning; quality-recall trade-off persists
representative_papers.approach: Evidence chain mining with constrained decoding and activated search for holistic quality optimization
representative_papers.contribution: NeocorRAG metric Recall Conversion Rate quantifies retrieval contribution; improves recall and reasoning

representative_papers.title: Cross-city Time Series Forecasting with Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
representative_papers.problem: Cross-city time series forecasting with data sparsity; irrelevant source knowledge hinders target performance
representative_papers.approach: RAG-LLM framework with selective retriever filtering relevant patterns from data-rich cities as structured prompts
representative_papers.contribution: xRAG4TS enables interpretable forecasting in data-scarce cities by selective knowledge transfer from source cities

representative_papers.title: Bridging Expert Reasoning and LLM Detection: A Knowledge-Driven Framework for Malicious Packages
representative_papers.problem: Open-source package detection relies on fragile handcrafted rules failing to capture evolving malicious behavior.
representative_papers.approach: Retrieval-augmented generation framework integrating expert reasoning from threat intelligence knowledge base.
representative_papers.contribution: IntelGuard achieves 99% accuracy detecting malicious packages including 54 previously unreported on PyPI.

representative_papers.title: Active Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Conflict-Fused Uncertainty Quantification
representative_papers.problem: Active RAG methods retrieve too late and use single uncertainty signals for triggering retrieval.
representative_papers.approach: Decompose questions into steps with multi-signal uncertainty quantification and conflict fusion.
representative_papers.contribution: Conflict-fused uncertainty captures distributional uncertainty and cross-sample consensus.

representative_papers.title: FlowRAG: Continual Learning for Dynamic Retriever in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: Dense retrievers degrade with evolving corpora; continuous retraining is computationally expensive.
representative_papers.approach: Layer-wise prompt embeddings and generator-guided loss for lightweight continual adaptation.
representative_papers.contribution: FlowRAG updates 0.64% parameters, improving retrieval and generation in non-stationary corpora.

representative_papers.title: KEPo: Knowledge Evolution Poison on Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: GraphRAG systems vulnerable to poisoning attacks that manipulate knowledge graphs and LLM outputs
representative_papers.approach: Knowledge evolution poison attacks forging event backgrounds and interconnected knowledge evolution paths
representative_papers.contribution: KEPo exposes latent GraphRAG security vulnerabilities through poisoned KG manipulation

representative_papers.title: SeaRAG: Reducing Hallucination in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Statement-Entity Adaptive Ranking
representative_papers.problem: RAG methods miss entity and statement level verification; dynamic control ignores combined aspects
representative_papers.approach: Training-free adaptive RAG probing entities and statements via entropy-based uncertainty
representative_papers.contribution: SeaRAG reduces hallucinations by 11.1 percent on TriviaQA while cutting retrieval frequency

representative_papers.title: Beyond Factual Queries: A Novel Predictive Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: RAG optimized for factual QA rather than predictive tasks requiring inference of unknown outcomes
representative_papers.approach: PRAG adaptively integrates historical interaction similarity as prompt weights for personalized inference
representative_papers.contribution: Significantly improves predictive recommendation by capturing user-specific preference signals

representative_papers.title: MGK-RAG: Multi-Granularity Knowledge Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Radiology Report
representative_papers.problem: RAG for radiology ignores fine-grained hierarchical pathological knowledge in reports
representative_papers.approach: Multi-granularity semantic similarity-guided contrastive learning and cross-attention fusion
representative_papers.contribution: MGK-RAG improves radiology report factual accuracy via hierarchical semantic alignment

representative_papers.title: Agent-Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph RAG for Academic Question Answering
representative_papers.problem: RAG systems lack adaptive retrieval, sufficiency evaluation, and graph verification for academic QA
representative_papers.approach: Agentic heterogeneous graph RAG with query-aware retrieval, sufficiency-aware reranking, graph verification
representative_papers.contribution: Multi-stage agent pipeline improves academic QA over strong LLM and graph-augmented baselines

representative_papers.title: HyperRAG: Reasoning N-ary Facts over Hypergraphs for Retrieval Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: Binary knowledge graphs fragment complex n-ary facts; longer reasoning paths increase drift
representative_papers.approach: HyperRAG: n-ary hypergraph retrieval with structural-semantic reasoning and LLM memory
representative_papers.contribution: 2.95% MRR and 1.23% Hits@10 gains on multi-hop QA via adaptive hypergraph traversal

representative_papers.title: S-Path-RAG: Semantic-Aware Shortest-Path Retrieval Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering
representative_papers.problem: Multi-hop KGQA struggles with token efficiency and semantic path selection in large knowledge graphs
representative_papers.approach: Semantic-aware shortest-path RAG using hybrid weighted k-shortest paths with neural-Socratic dialogue loop
representative_papers.contribution: S-Path-RAG achieves token-efficient topology-aware retrieval with interpretable path traces for multi-hop QA

representative_papers.title: CompactRAG: Reducing LLM Calls and Token Overhead in Multi-Hop Question Answering
representative_papers.problem: Multi-hop RAG inefficient: repeated LLM calls, high token consumption, unstable entity grounding across hops
representative_papers.approach: Decouple corpus restructuring into atomic QA KB from reasoning; entity-consistent query decomposition with dense retrieval
representative_papers.contribution: Only two total LLM calls regardless of hops; substantially reduces token consumption vs iterative RAG

representative_papers.title: RAG-GFM: Overcoming In-Memory Bottlenecks in Graph Foundation Models via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: Graph foundation models limited by in-memory bottlenecks and lossy parameter compression
representative_papers.approach: Retrieval-augmented generation with dual-modal unified retrieval and dual-view alignment
representative_papers.contribution: RAG-GFM offloads knowledge from parameters improving scalability and interpretability

representative_papers.title: Reasoning in Trees: Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Question Answering
representative_papers.problem: Multi-hop question answering via RAG suffers from inaccurate decomposition and error propagation
representative_papers.approach: Reasoning Tree Guided RAG: explicit tree decomposition with consensus selection and bottom-up traversal
representative_papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art by 7.0% F1 and 6.0% EM on complex QA

representative_papers.title: A Unified Framework for Context-Aware and Relation-Aware Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: Graph RAG methods separate entity and chunk retrieval, missing emergent knowledge from synthesis
representative_papers.approach: Hierarchical graph RAG with hybrid nodes, iterative clustering, LLM summaries, multi-level retrieval
representative_papers.contribution: HyGRAG synthesizes contextual and relational information, enabling efficient dynamic knowledge updates

representative_papers.title: Rethinking Soft Compression in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Query-Conditioned Selector Perspective
representative_papers.problem: RAG scalability limited by excessive context and soft compression methods failing due to full-document encoding ignoring query
representative_papers.approach: SeleCom decoder-only selector redefined as query-conditioned information filter trained with curriculum learning on synthetic QA
representative_papers.contribution: Query-conditioned soft compression outperforms full-compression and rivals non-compression baselines while reducing latency

representative_papers.title: Rigorizing Retrieval-augmented Generation with Structured Knowledge Intelligence (6 Hrs)
representative_papers.problem: RAG systems inadequately model heterogeneous structured knowledge and lack safety considerations
representative_papers.approach: Structured perspective on RAG covering tabular, social network, and document tree designs
representative_papers.contribution: Tutorial framework for structured RAGs with security attack/defense strategies across knowledge types

representative_papers.title: MerFT: A Framework for Social Conflict Meme Exploration via Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Fine-tuning
representative_papers.problem: Harmful meme narratives circulate on social media without robust multimodal interpretation
representative_papers.approach: Multimodal retrieval-augmented fine-tuning with distractor-aware chain-of-thought reasoning
representative_papers.contribution: MerFT framework improves meme interpretation robustness against misleading distractors via RAG

representative_papers.title: Planning Before Retrieval: A Constrained Planner–Executor Framework for Reliable and Efficient KG-Augmented Reasoning
representative_papers.problem: KG-RAG systems lack interpretability and structured planning for reliable reasoning
representative_papers.approach: Planner-executor framework formalizing retrieval as structured planning problem
representative_papers.contribution: Controlled auditable reasoning integrating explicit planning into KG-RAG systems

representative_papers.title: Leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Language Models for Accurate Item/Feature Selection in Conversational Recommender Systems
representative_papers.problem: RALMs for CRS include irrelevant knowledge limiting recommendation and explanation quality
representative_papers.approach: Multi-stage item/feature selection with Chain-of-Thought reasoning
representative_papers.contribution: MOCHA framework improves recommendation accuracy with factually-correct explanations

representative_papers.title: Web-Mined Hypothesis Generation for Financial Markets: An Autonomous Backtesting Framework
representative_papers.problem: Financial hypothesis generation is slow, subjective, lacking automation for web data
representative_papers.approach: Knowledge graphs, retrieval-augmented generation, backtesting with optimization
representative_papers.contribution: AutoHypo-Fin autonomously generates tested trading strategies outperforming traditional methods

representative_papers.title: From Search to Ask to Act: The Evolution of Information Access in the Age of Large Models and Agents
representative_papers.problem: Information access needs to evolve from retrieval to reasoning, generation, and task execution
representative_papers.approach: Retrieval-augmented generation and AI agents combining reasoning models with active search
representative_papers.contribution: Framework exposes new IR problems in multi-step search, evidence refinement, and agent reasoning

representative_papers.title: Incentivizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Inner Adaptive Context Selection
representative_papers.problem: RAG with multiple retrieved documents increases context length, causing latency and performance degradation
representative_papers.approach: Inner adaptive context selection enabling LLMs to autonomously select relevant context during generation
representative_papers.contribution: Improved generation quality with computational efficiency via autonomous context selection

representative_papers.title: Search for Coverage: Learning Coverage-Aware Retrieval with Augmented Sub-Question Answerability
representative_papers.problem: Ranking methods for long-form RAG must ensure comprehensive relevant nugget coverage
representative_papers.approach: Dense bi-encoder with coverage-based contrastive and distillation objectives trained on synthetic coverage signals
representative_papers.contribution: Achieves 10% nugget coverage improvement over baselines while maintaining relevance

representative_papers.title: Chain of Evidence: Pixel-Level Visual Attribution for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: iRAG systems parse text losing visual semantics, provide coarse-grained attribution in lengthy documents
representative_papers.approach: Chain of Evidence leverages Vision-Language Models to reason over document screenshots with pixel-level attribution
representative_papers.contribution: Precise bounding boxes and visual reasoning chains eliminate format-specific parsing overhead

representative_papers.title: Beyond Semantic Relevance: Counterfactual Risk Minimization for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: Standard RAG maximizes relevance which paradoxically promotes retrieval of biased evidence reinforcing hallucinations
representative_papers.approach: CoRM-RAG uses cognitive perturbation protocol and Evidence Critic to align retrieval with decision safety
representative_papers.contribution: Counterfactual risk minimization framework enables robust evidence selection despite adversarial biases

representative_papers.title: SRAG: A Lightweight and Specialized Retrieval-augmented Generation System at the Edge
representative_papers.problem: Edge RAG systems struggle with generic monolithic knowledge bases poorly suited to heterogeneous queries.
representative_papers.approach: SRAG distributed system with domain-specialized knowledge bases and buffer-based knowledge migration across edge servers.
representative_papers.contribution: Improved retrieval accuracy, generation quality, and storage efficiency with reduced latency in edge RAG deployment.

representative_papers.title: Mixture-of-Retrieval Experts for Reasoning-Guided Multimodal Knowledge Exploitation
representative_papers.problem: Fixed retrieval paradigms in MRAG fail to exploit knowledge of different experts through dynamic interaction.
representative_papers.approach: MoRE framework with dynamic expert routing based on reasoning state and stepwise group relative policy optimization.
representative_papers.contribution: Dynamic coordination of multiple retrieval experts achieving 7% performance gain in open-domain QA.

representative_papers.title: Question-Adaptive Graph Learning for Multi-hop Retrieval Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: Multi-hop RAG struggles with complex semantic structures and irrelevant noise in retrieval.
representative_papers.approach: Quest-GNN performs adaptive graph learning on Multi-L KG with question-guided message passing.
representative_papers.contribution: Question-adaptive framework with synthesized pre-training data improves multi-hop retrieval.

representative_papers.title: FAIR-RAG: An End-to-End Framework for Mitigating Political Bias through Fair Retrieval-Augmented Generation
representative_papers.problem: RAG systems amplify political bias from web corpora into responses
representative_papers.approach: Multi-LLM persona annotation, political-stance metadata, multi-stage fairness engine
representative_papers.contribution: Framework achieving 97.51 Attention Weighted Rank Fairness with 82% improvement

representative_papers.title: mKG-RAG: Leveraging Multimodal Knowledge Graphs in Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-intensive VQA
representative_papers.problem: RAG-based VQA uses unstructured docs, overlooks semantic relations in knowledge
representative_papers.approach: Multimodal knowledge graph construction with MLLM extraction and dual-stage retrieval
representative_papers.contribution: Structured multimodal KG integration improves VQA through refined semantic knowledge
